clusters.name: Expressive, bright, romantic warmth
clusters.reading: The measured neighbours are not quiet: they are melodic Latin pop ballads and a bright, emotional, romantic musical telenovela. Read against the seeds, this is the warm, sun-struck, danceable side of Khruangbin's global funk rather than a hushed storybook. The palette goes hot and saturated (terracotta, marigold, magenta-rose on deep indigo) and the type gets an expressive, high-contrast display face with real swagger.

clusters.name: Coastal bohemian, vintage prints, made by hand
clusters.reading: The aesthetic tags are the clearest link to the seeds: coastal, bohemian, vintage prints and craftsmanship. Port Calder is a harbour town, so the imagery becomes a screen-printed travel-poster look: flat two- or three-colour inks, a sun over the bay, misregistered layers, and walk cards that read like printed tickets or record sleeves.

clusters.name: Passionate, compassionate journey
clusters.reading: Passion, compassion and 'the journey' set the voice: warm, direct, a little exclamatory, inviting the visitor to fall for the city stop by stop. The walk in progress is framed as a journey you are on, with encouragement at each stop rather than neutral status text.

setAside.reason: A superhero blockbuster of near-total popularity (0.9993); its destruction and laser-gun tags reflect general popularity drift, not a usable register for a gentle self-guided walking app.

approach: The measured profile overturned my storybook-watercolour prediction: none of my 23 predicted entities came back and every quality was a surprise. I keep what the measurement agrees on — expressive, emotional, romantic, passionate, coastal, bohemian, vintage prints — and translate it into a hot, screen-printed coastal poster style with an expressive display face and a warm, passionate voice. The mainstream brand and book results (Instagram, Nike, self-help titles) are popularity noise and are not used.
